spots.name: Passion of Sacco and Vanzetti
spots.blurb: You've reached Passion of Sacco and Vanzetti, a mural by Ben Shahn from 1967. It shows Sacco and Vanzetti. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.
